values.task_boundary: Inventory the complete current denominator, execute only proof-supported deletion bands, validate exact behavior and rollback, and publish the truthful achieved reduction. Stop rather than absorb migration or aesthetic refactoring.
deliverables: Proof-led independently reversible dead-code reductions under adl/src
Exact-head macOS and hosted Linux proof
acceptance_criteria: AC1: #308 terminal/canonical/ancestral/clean truth and the exact e926e3bc execution baseline are verified before deletion.

AC2: Every baseline adl/src Rust file and every normalized active reference edge has exactly one valid disposition with stable identity, owner, evidence, validation, and rollback source; the scanned path/blob denominator is complete.
AC3: Every currently provable dead or superseded path is removed without moving, hiding, gating, or copying it into an unowned compatibility surface.
AC4: Runtime v2 paths remain only for exact active consumers or timed exceptions; additional migration is recorded and left to its owner.
AC5: Supported commands, exit codes, artifacts, traces, persistence, errors, clean installation, Runtime v3 behavior, and #414 continuity retain parity on macOS and required Linux proof.
AC6: Each band is one commit with an exact blob manifest and executable git revert/reapply proof that preserves unrelated later work.
AC7: Exact physical file and line reduction against the pinned baseline is reported without a pass/fail quota and every retained path has accountable authority.
AC8: One exact-head independent review has no unresolved actionable finding and the implementation PR uses Closes #309 without claiming #310 or milestone completion.
dependencies: Current Runtime v2 and Runtime v3 production consumers
repo_inputs: current module graph, CLI routes, docs, tests, artifacts, and repository-wide references
non_goals: New product features or Runtime v4 migration
Deleting active Runtime v2 authority without a landed replacement
